title: Zero-dimensional graphene-core carbon nanodots confined in mesoporous silica for π-selective extraction of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons from lipophilic media
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00322B, Paper
Nathália Carvalho da Silva, Albina Mikhraliieva, Renato da Silva Carreira, Carlos German Massone, Volodymyr Zaitsev
We report a bimodal amphiphilic adsorbent confining graphene-core carbon nanodots in the silica network for selective PAH extraction from non-polar media.
